"""LAMP stack sample focused on Info card fields only."""

from scryr.manifest import Diagram, Link, Manifest
from scryr.saas import Classification
from scryr.types import (
    AuthType,
    DeploymentTarget,
    IaCToolType,
    LogAggregationType,
    MonitoringType,
    ProgrammingLanguage,
    SemVer,
    TracingType,
    Url,
    WebFramework,
)

linux_host_block = Manifest(
    name="Linux Host",
    classification=Classification.network_gateway,
    connections=["Apache Web Server", "PHP Application", "MySQL Database"],
    description="Ubuntu VM providing the operating system, firewall rules, process supervision, and local package management for the LAMP deployment.",
    version=SemVer("22.4.0"),
    language=ProgrammingLanguage.bash,
    deployment=DeploymentTarget.vm,
    owner_team="Platform Team",
    auth_type=AuthType.service_account,
    monitoring=MonitoringType.prometheus,
    log_aggregation=LogAggregationType.elk_stack,
    tracing=TracingType.none,
    iac_tool=IaCToolType.terraform,
    docs=["https://ubuntu.com/server/docs"],
)

apache_web_block = Manifest(
    name="Apache Web Server",
    classification=Classification.public_ui,
    connections=["PHP Application"],
    description="Apache HTTP Server terminates browser traffic, serves static assets, and forwards dynamic page requests to the PHP application runtime.",
    version=SemVer("2.4.0"),
    language=ProgrammingLanguage.html,
    deployment=DeploymentTarget.vm,
    owner_team="Web Team",
    auth_type=AuthType.basic,
    monitoring=MonitoringType.prometheus,
    log_aggregation=LogAggregationType.elk_stack,
    tracing=TracingType.none,
    iac_tool=IaCToolType.terraform,
    docs=["https://httpd.apache.org/docs/2.4/"],
    links=[Link(site_name="Example Site", http_url=Url("https://lamp.example.com"))],
)

php_app_block = Manifest(
    name="PHP Application",
    classification=Classification.internal_api,
    connections=["MySQL Database"],
    description="PHP application layer rendering server-side pages, handling form submissions, and coordinating reads and writes against MySQL.",
    version=SemVer("8.3.0"),
    language=ProgrammingLanguage.php,
    frameworks=[WebFramework.laravel],
    deployment=DeploymentTarget.vm,
    owner_team="App Team",
    auth_type=AuthType.jwt,
    monitoring=MonitoringType.prometheus,
    log_aggregation=LogAggregationType.elk_stack,
    tracing=TracingType.none,
    iac_tool=IaCToolType.terraform,
    docs=["https://www.php.net/manual/en/", "https://laravel.com/docs"],
)

mysql_database_block = Manifest(
    name="MySQL Database",
    classification=Classification.database,
    description="Relational datastore for users, sessions, application content, and transactional records used by the PHP application.",
    version=SemVer("8.4.0"),
    language=ProgrammingLanguage.sql,
    deployment=DeploymentTarget.vm,
    owner_team="Data Team",
    auth_type=AuthType.basic,
    monitoring=MonitoringType.prometheus,
    log_aggregation=LogAggregationType.elk_stack,
    tracing=TracingType.none,
    iac_tool=IaCToolType.terraform,
    docs=["https://dev.mysql.com/doc/"],
)

lamp_diagram = Diagram(
    name="LAMP",
    manifests=[
        linux_host_block,
        apache_web_block,
        php_app_block,
        mysql_database_block,
    ],
)
